# Public upstream fixtures

`podvm-v0.3.13.json` is the unmodified public unified release asset:
https://github.com/prem-research/podvm/releases/download/v0.3.13/measurements.json

Source revision: `98fb81edf7284bc44f503ce21347f440acb0e3a6`
SHA-256: `2dc23f10f9a31367cffd804d7655effc1e5bdc256301bd7b42c4d73d3d4de481`

It contains the CPU profile and seven NVIDIA GPU profiles, both bundle digests,
and per-variant provenance. Tests exercise every profile, preserve GPU metadata,
and ensure GPU TDX candidates cannot become reference records.

`podvm-v0.1.6.json` preserves the unmodified legacy single CPU bundle asset:
https://github.com/prem-research/podvm/releases/download/v0.1.6/measurements.json

SHA-256: `3cd0e61ea7efc251a051743ca6e8adf31783d185925827ee78344e5e65908d94`

Unit tests replace the network and signature verifier explicitly. Production code
has no switch to bypass verification. Live integration uses real attestations.

`trustbase-v1.1.1/` and `trustbase-v1.1.2/` contain the three immutable public
payload assets from:
https://github.com/prem-research/trustbase/releases/tag/v1.1.1
https://github.com/prem-research/trustbase/releases/tag/v1.1.2

SHA-256:
- v1.1.1 `measurements.json`: `70faf3d205305dd7fe1a6e4dcee60c2183c40064ad4f002282a59155f37974aa`
- v1.1.1 input archive: `a401b160f3ca16dd066e4115d4229e80d28d7dc78a5491ce529a03cefb06a102`
- v1.1.2 `measurements.json`: `254c6c62b6ced0926cce8fa8d88af77f2b2c94e6856bad41e7287b064ed1ab44`
- v1.1.2 input archive: `858237d7ff44b65714e7e6f105103ed1c0f9cb32793b68442097027bd96b4c58`
- Both `policies.json` files: `1b37a4694cd3ea6fc70ed8b6a098a971dd33485496cec029b00ce13badcceadc`

These input archives predate processor-keyed TDX references. Their bytes exercise
actual historical verification, their original chain, and successor chaining,
rather than archives regenerated by the checkout under test. Only external
signature verification is mocked; no attestation bundle is stored in these
public fixtures.
